summary: Full backend + frontend test of the three new features: (1) Provider Settings screen (GET/PUT /api/provider-settings), (2) Warehouse (Magazzino) module with inventory-enabled materials + carico/scarico + auto-deduct on issued declarations, (3) save-new-material prompt in declaration wizard step 3. Backend: 29/29 pytest passing (12 new + 17 regression). Frontend UI tested end-to-end at 390x844 mobile viewport, JWT tecnico@lab.it: Magazzino tab renders with correct empty state and 'Vai all\'Anagrafica' CTA; Anagrafica → materials form now shows 'Gestisci giacenza (magazzino)' toggle that reveals unit/stock/min_stock/location fields when enabled; after saving a tracked material (TEST Zirc UI2, stock=12) it appears in Magazzino (1 materiale tracciato); scarico -2 correctly updates 12 → 10 with 'Scarico registrato' toast; Provider settings accessible from Profilo → 'open-provider-settings' with 3 sections (Firma digitale, PEC, Conservazione a norma) each with its enable toggle, plus notes; PUT persists (signature_provider='Aruba TEST', pec_address='labtest@pec.aruba.it', conservation_provider='Namirial TEST', signature_enabled=true → badge changes from 'Non attivo' to 'Predisposto'); Declaration wizard step 3: adding a custom material with 'add-custom-material' → 'confirm-custom-material' triggers the 'Salvare in anagrafica?' FormSheet with save-new-material-yes/no; tap Sì creates the material via POST /api/materials, shows 'Materiale salvato in anagrafica' toast, and the new item appears as a library chip. All flows working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py get_provider_settings/list_materials use a walrus-inside-dict-comprehension pattern `{k: v for k in Model.model_fields.keys() if (v := doc.get(k)) is not None}`. This correctly filters None but silently drops any field explicitly set to 0/False/'' only if the DB stored them as None. For inventory fields (stock=0, track_stock=False) this is fine because they are stored as 0/False, not None, but any legacy doc missing the key will fall back to Pydantic default — works but subtle.

backend/server.py create_declaration auto-deduct block does not clamp new_stock at 0; issuing a declaration with qty > stock will produce a NEGATIVE stock in the DB. Consider max(0, new_stock) or reject the declaration. Also does not record a movement log, so audit trail of automatic scarico is missing.
backend/server.py adjust_material_stock similarly allows negative deltas to push stock below zero without validation.

frontend warehouse.tsx confirmAdjust: after scarico the request goes through but if server rejects (future validation) the local `load()` still refetches — OK. However there is no confirmation step for scarico that would send stock negative; the button remains enabled.

frontend declaration/new.tsx saveNewToLibrary: when a material is saved via the prompt, only the FIRST matching entry (by name+manufacturer) gets material_id patched. If the user added the same custom material multiple times, only one is linked. Minor edge case.
seed_data_creation: During UI test created TEST Zirc UI2 and TEST CustomMat NEW materials; both cleaned up via DELETE /api/materials after the run. Provider settings for tecnico@lab.it now contain: signature_provider='Aruba TEST', signature_enabled=true, pec_address='labtest@pec.aruba.it', conservation_provider='Namirial TEST', notes='UI test note'. If undesired, main agent should reset via PUT with empty payload.
